blockingHostContracts.summary: Add a capability-gated, host-side idempotent ctx.projects.create(input) to plugin SDK API v1 with atomic plugin-origin binding and lookup by (companyId, pluginId, idempotencyKey).
Expose the core document service's required baseRevisionId through the plugin protocol, host bridge, and SDK so existing documents can be updated atomically without blind overwrites.

disclaimer: The audited commit is development metadata only.
It is not a production compatibility promise.
Public Mission Control packages must not claim compatibility with an unreleased Paperclip host.
The minimum host version is set only after both blocking contracts are merged and released.
